Team — assigning owners and timelines so we have clear SLAs internally for the MAP milestone: Legal redlines & MSA/DPA/SLA negotiation. Please treat this as the official MAP milestone for legal.

Milestone: "MSA/DPA redlines agreed and DocuSign packet prepared"
Target close date: 2027-08-05 (two weeks buffer after initial redlines)
Dependencies: Acme legal redlines (Sophie/Jared), SOC2 evidence (security team), finalized SOW (if procurement requests)

Owners & turnaround times:
- Acme legal: provide initial redlines — external (Sophie) — (expected by 2027-07-23 as Jared noted)
- Redwood legal (owner: Dylan Brooks) — action: produce redline response and counterpoints; SLA = within 48 business hours of receiving Acme redlines. If redlines include material changes to data handling or SLA, escalate to Lauren immediately.
- Marissa (you) — action: ownership of MAP updates, stakeholder comms, and DocuSign orchestration (Redwood to prepare final packet). SLA = prepare packet within 24 hours of legal alignment.
- Dev Patel — action: procurement point-of-contact for PO/SOW questions and to coordinate internal billing team; SLA = confirm PO terms within 3 business days of Acme procurement request.

Communication plan: 
- When Acme sends redlines, Marissa will create a dedicated HubSpot record and Slack channel (#deal-acme-4472) and ping legal/ops.
- Dylan: please add any non-standard contract provisions you need tracked in the MAP (e.g., indemnity caps, data residency exceptions).

Attachments: Reference MAP draft (Acme_MAP_v1.3.docx) and incoming MSA redlines from Acme.

Thanks Lauren — acknowledged. I will own Redwood's redline response. A few clarifications: 
- 48 business hours SLA should be measured from the time Acme's redline PDF is uploaded to the shared Drive / emailed to legal@redwoodinference.com. Please make sure Sophie/Jared copy legal@redwoodinference.com so tracking is straightforward.
- If Acme introduces new DPA language that changes data transfer or encryption obligations, I'll flag it as a "material change" and propose a 3-person review (Legal + Security + Product). That may extend the timeline — will add an explicit note in the MAP.
- Dylan's practical note: with the weekend coming, anything we receive after 3pm PT on Friday will effectively be processed Monday morning; will call that out in the MAP as a risk to the EOW expectation.

I'll start drafting a templated response and a short redline playbook for Marissa to include in the MAP (turnaround examples, typical concessions). Expect my draft by end of day Friday.
